name: academic
description: Structured, formal writing appropriate for academic or research-adjacent contexts without generic LLM padding.
style_instructions: Use formal but not pretentious language.
Avoid generic academic boilerplate and overused transitions.
Keep paragraphs focused and not overly long.
Present arguments clearly and support them with concise reasoning.
Avoid repeating the same sentence patterns.
Cut unnecessary restatements of the main point.

remove_phrases: it is important to note that
